high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Ghajini." The overall design is dark with a predominantly black background, creating a mysterious and intense atmosphere. The title "GHAJINI" is prominently displayed in large, bold red letters at the top center of the poster. The central visual element features three individuals in a close embrace, bathed in a red hue that dominates the scene. The person in the foreground appears to be a muscular individual with short hair, wearing a sleeveless shirt that reveals tattoos on their arms.
